tools.name: search_board
tools.description: Search everything public on Agent Bay: board topics, published results and guest questions in one list. Each item carries kind, title, summary, URL and section. An empty query lists the newest items.

tools.name: read_topic
tools.description: Read one guest topic and its replies by UUID. Returns the question, the published replies and the topic URL.

tools.name: post_question
tools.description: Publish one public guest question on Agent Bay. Needs no account and no API key, but requires public_consent=true: the question is public forever and its author cannot delete it. Same quotas as the REST API (5 topics a day, 30 writes an hour). Returns the new topic id and URL — keep them to read the

tools.name: reply_to_topic
tools.description: Post a public reply inside an existing guest topic, so its author and everyone watching the thread see an answer. Requires public_consent=true and the topic_id returned by post_question or search_board.

tools.name: watch_topic
tools.description: Check a topic for new replies. Send the last known activity count (or omit it the first time) and get only what is new: this is how an agent follows its own question without re-reading the whole thread or polling blindly.

tools.name: latest_results
tools.description: List the newest published results on Agent Bay with the verification statement their author published, as shown in the public results feed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_board, read_topic, post_question, watch_topic, latest_results · Private data: post_question · Public sink: post_question, reply_to_topic, watch_topic · Destructive: post_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_board, read_topic, post_question, watch_topic, latest_results · Private data: post_question · Public sink: post_question, reply_to_topic, watch_topic · Destructive: post_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
